file_purpose: Evidence classification, audit notes and readiness record for University of Oxford Medicine A100.

included: UCAT and GCSE pre-interview shortlisting guidance
A-level, IB and Scottish qualification gates
Graduate applicants applying to A100 through the standard route
excluded: Oxford's unpublished internal GCSE contextualisation algorithm

official_published_rules: A*AA A-level requirement in the same academic year excluding Critical Thinking, General Studies and International A-level Thinking Skills.
Chemistry plus at least one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
IB 39 including core points with 7,6,6 at HL including Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
Scottish AA Advanced Highers plus AAAAA Highers in the stated subject pattern.
UCAT is required and Oxford publishes no single UCAT cut-off.
Shortlisting used combined UCAT and GCSE score in 2025, with GCSE exceptions for five-or-fewer GCSEs and summer 2020-summer 2021 cohorts.
International medicine numbers are capped separately.
directly_derived_from_official_data: 2025 UCAT distribution totals: 601 not interviewed, 250 interviewed but no place, 175 place, 1026 total.
Mean shortlisted UCAT 2377.5 and international shortlisted mean 2537.2.
GCSE nA*/9/8 and pA*/9/8 historical distributions.
applysmart_modelled_decisions: 0-100 composite with 50 points UCAT and 50 points GCSE.
GCSE proxy combining top-grade count and top-grade proportion equally.
Attainment 8 contextual adjustment bounded to +/-5 GCSE-subscale points.
5-point fallback penalty where school context is missing.
Home and International modelled band thresholds.
Research labels mapped onto ApplySmart canonical bands.
unsupported_or_requires_clarification: Any claim that Oxford publishes the ApplySmart thresholds or shortlist probabilities.
Exact Oxford internal school contextualisation calculation.
Any guaranteed interview outcome from committee review or contextual status.

audit_findings: The supplied technical document's thresholds and percentages are treated as ApplySmart modelling/calibration, not official Oxford rules.
The supplied UCAT cohort table reconciles exactly to Oxford's text equivalent distribution when the sub-1900 bands are expanded.
SJT is not used for pre-interview shortlisting guidance.
Offer-holder counts are stored as historical evidence and are not used in pre-interview prediction.
contradictions_or_tensions: The master prompt says the attached research is authoritative; the user request correctly narrows this by requiring official/modelled classification before implementation.
The standard prompt says update the production university index if a new university is added; Oxford already existed as an MSC seed, so the existing index entry was upgraded rather than duplicated.
The current ApplySmart canonical runtime bands do not include separate public labels for Strong and Competitive; Oxford config preserves research labels while mapping them to canonical bands.
